anchor.after: // ChargeIssues says what went wrong with a charge, from the charge itself and the webhook log the shop keeps.

messages.author: Claude
messages.body:
**9. Asynchronous hop 3: the bank answers the provider (not our code)**

Once the customer confirms (or does not), the bank answers the provider, which marks the charge succeeded, failed or expired and posts a webhook to the shop. The shop has no handle on that exchange: per the comment at payments/status.go:41-42 all it sees is what the provider reports, so it reads the charge's failure text and matches the bank's decline wording with regexes (:36-38). These are called from `processOrder` (worker/worker.go:128).
